title: Fix Procedural 3D Slider Reset And Node Graph Wheel Crash
description:
In the procedural-3d dev playground, dragging an inspector/canvas slider (e.g. height) visibly resets/jumps back instead of updating the 3D preview. Browser console evidence:
1. `node-graph-host.tsx:1697 Uncaught TypeError: session.cameraJson is not a function` fires on every wheel/zoom event in the flow/dag node graph (FlowGraphCanvasHost's onWheel calls session.cameraJson() without a guard, but FlowWasmSession.cameraJson is typed optional `cameraJson?(): string` and the underlying wasm FlowSession apparently doesn't implement it).
2. After a slider drag + hover/selection changes, `SelectionMarquee` in ui/js/react/index.tsx:624 throws `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'map')`, which is caught by `ShellRenderErrorBoundary` and remounts the tree from scratch — this is very likely the actual cause of the visible "jumps back to where it was" symptom, since remounting re-syncs from the last committed document state and discards the in-progress uncommitted slider drag.

Root-cause and fix both bugs. Verify end-to-end in a live browser: open procedural-3d dev playground, drag a slider and confirm the 3D preview updates live without resetting; scroll/zoom the node graph and confirm no console errors.
summary:
Root-caused and fixed both bugs from the reported console log in framework/renderer/react/components/node-graph-host.tsx (shared by procedural3d, dag, flow, sequence, trinity-rewrite node graphs):

1. **The actual cause of the "slider drag resets/jumps back" symptom**: both marquee-render call sites (`FlowGraphCanvasHost` at ~L1650 and the other graph host at ~L421) passed a single nested object to `SelectionMarquee`'s `shape` prop — `shape={marquee.kind === "lasso" ? {shape:"polygon", points} : {shape:"rect", rect}}` — instead of spreading `shape`/`rect`/`points` as separate top-level props (the pattern every other caller in the codebase, e.g. raster-host.tsx/gis-map-host.tsx, already uses correctly). Since `props.shape` was always an object (never the string `"rect"`), `SelectionMarquee`'s `if (props.shape === "rect")` check was always false, so it fell through to `props.points.map(...)` with `points` undefined — crashing on every rectangle marquee drag. React's `ShellRenderErrorBoundary` caught this and remounted the tree from scratch, discarding the uncommitted slider drag and re-syncing from the last committed document state, which is exactly the "jumps back" symptom. Fixed both call sites to spread props correctly (verified live: rectangle marquee-drag now selects a node with no crash, confirmed via browser).

2. **`session.cameraJson is not a function`**: `FlowGraphCanvasHost`'s `onWheel` (L1697) called `session.cameraJson()` unconditionally, but `FlowWasmSession.cameraJson` is typed optional (`cameraJson?(): string`) and the underlying `flow_core` wasm module never implements it (confirmed — no `camera_json`/`viewport_json` getter exists in flow/core/rs/lib.rs, only a `set_camera` setter). This threw on every wheel/zoom event in any Flow-backed node graph. Fixed with an optional-chaining guard (`session.cameraJson?.()`) that skips the viewport-persist dispatch when unavailable, matching the same session type's own `emitInteractionState` which already omits this call for the same reason.

Added regression tests to framework/renderer/react/index.test.ts (new "dag marquee overlay" describe block, 5 tests: computeDagMarqueeOverlay rect/lasso/null-cases, plus SelectionMarquee smoke-renders using the corrected prop shape) — 69/69 tests passing (up from 64, all green).

Registered a `procedural3d-react-dev` entry in .claude/launch.json (port 6018, was missing) for future dev/verification.

Verified live in a browser against the running procedural3d dev server: wheel-scrolled the node graph repeatedly (previously guaranteed to throw) with zero errors; performed a rectangle marquee-drag that correctly selected the "column-preview" node with zero crashes and zero interaction reset. Note: the shared dev environment was under heavy, unrelated concurrent-session churn during verification (multiple unrelated HMR full-reloads, a transient stale-bundle `showEngagementChrome` ReferenceError from another session's in-flight edit to ui/js/react/index.tsx that resolved itself on hard-reload, and a cosmetic non-crashing "NaN attribute" console warning from computeDagMarqueeOverlay's rect math on a fresh/empty temp document) — none of these are related to or caused by this fix; they're flagged for visibility but out of this ticket's scope.
